surface_mechanism_description: The surface reactions during PEALD of Al2O3 using TMA and DMAD on PP involve the interaction of precursor molecules with surface hydroxyl groups. The growth mechanism is influenced by the precursor chemistry, with TMA showing a different growth mode compared to DMAD due to the presence of different ligands. The surface reaction steps include the adsorption of precursor molecules, surface reactions leading to the formation of Al-O-Al bonds, and the regeneration of surface hydroxyl groups through plasma treatment.
